title: Flows
subtitle: Multi-step automations that chain tools together.

empty.title: No flows yet
empty.body: Ask Breeze AI to draft a flow, then review it here.

pausedReason.drift: Paused because the flow changed after it was enabled.
pausedReason.binding_drift: Paused because a pre-approved script or target changed.
pausedReason.delegator_inactive: Paused because the person it runs on behalf of is no longer active.
pausedReason.org_merged: Paused because the organization was merged.
pausedReason.event_dispatch_not_durable: Paused because event delivery is not durable on this server.

enable.title: Enable flow
enable.body: Enabling publishes this version of the flow. It then runs on its trigger. Steps that need approval still ask for it unless you pre-approve them below.
enable.preApproveHelp: Runs of this version skip the approval prompt for this step. Pre-approval covers exactly the script and target shown here and stops applying if the flow changes.

notEligible.not_tier3: Only steps that need approval can be pre-approved.
notEligible.script_not_literal: The script is chosen at run time, so it cannot be pre-approved.
notEligible.run_context_not_literal: The run-as setting is chosen at run time, so it cannot be pre-approved.
notEligible.group_target: This step targets a device group, which can change. Pre-approval needs fixed devices.
notEligible.variable_dependent: This step depends on values that are only known at run time.
notEligible.script_not_found: The script this step uses could not be found.
notEligible.four_eyes: This action always needs a second person to approve it.
notEligible.tenant_tool: Custom tool sources cannot be pre-approved.

enable.eventScope: Event flows react to platform events whatever caused them, including actions taken by people, other flows, or automations. Check the trigger filter before you enable it.
enable.missingPermissions: You are missing permissions that this flow's steps need:
enable.eventNotDurable: Event delivery is not durable on this server, so event flows cannot be enabled right now.
enable.forEachConcurrency: Steps that repeat for each item run one item at a time.
enable.noTier3: No step in this flow needs approval.
enable.validationFailed: The flow has validation errors. Fix them before enabling:
enable.versionConflict: The flow changed since you opened this page. Reload it and review the changes before enabling.
enable.foreachConcurrencyNotAvailable: This flow repeats a step for each item in parallel, which this server does not support yet.
enable.delegationScopeRestricted: Your access is limited to some sites, so you cannot enable a flow that runs across the whole organization.
enable.partnerWideForbidden: You do not have permission to enable flows for all organizations.
enable.interactiveRequired: Flows can only be enabled from a signed-in browser session.
enable.slugUnavailable: Another flow in this scope already uses this identifier.

run.title: Run flow
run.queueFull: This flow has too many runs waiting. Try again once some have finished.
run.permissionMissing: You do not have permission to run the steps of this flow: {{permissions}}
run.preApprovalsNotHonored: This run was started by someone without approval rights, so pre-approvals were not applied and each step asks for approval.
run.orgRequired: Choose the organization to run this flow in.
run.notEnabled: This flow is not enabled, so it cannot be run.
run.delegationScopeRestricted: Your access is limited to some sites, so you cannot run a flow that works across the whole organization.
run.interactiveUserRequired: Only a signed-in person can start a manual run. Sign in to the web app and try again.
run.orgForbidden: You do not have access to that organization.
run.notManual: This flow does not run manually. It starts from its trigger.

runDetail.title: Flow run
runDetail.awaitingApproval: This run is paused until someone approves a step.

error.drift: The flow changed after it was enabled, so the run was stopped.
error.binding_drift: A pre-approved script or target changed, so the run was stopped.
error.unknown_outcome: The result of a step is unknown. The step may have run. Check the device by hand before running the flow again.
error.step_timeout: A step took too long and was stopped.
error.input_invalid: A step received input it could not use.
error.reference_not_owned: A step referred to something that belongs to another organization.
error.tool_unavailable: A tool used by this flow is no longer available.
error.tool_blocked: A tool used by this flow is blocked.
error.too_many_items: A step would have repeated for more items than allowed.
error.render_failed: A step's input could not be built from earlier results.
error.no_eligible_approvers: No one is able to approve a step that needs approval.
error.worker_lost: The run was interrupted and could not continue.
error.run_timeout: The run took longer than the one-hour limit and was stopped.
error.flow_disabled: The flow was disabled while this run was active.
error.flows_disabled: Flows are turned off on this server.
error.delegator_inactive: The person this run acts for is no longer active.
error.org_merged: The organization was merged into another one.

step.truncated: Output was shortened because it was too large.
step.pruned: Details were removed by the retention policy.
step.redacted: Step details aren't available with your access.

runDetail.queuedNote: Queued. Waiting for a free run slot.

disable.title: Disable flow
disable.message: Disabling stops new runs and cancels runs that are in progress. You can enable the flow again later.
